invoice.notNumbered: Not numbered yet · the number is taken when posted
invoice.noRight: You can look at drafts, but making or posting a document needs the “Sales invoices · create” right. Ask Admin.
invoice.postedAs: Posted as {{no}}. The WhatsApp message is in the queue.

header.noCustomers: No customers for this company yet
header.kycPending: KYC is not verified yet: the bill is due the same day (cash sale) until Admin verifies it.
header.posHelp: The server decides CGST + SGST or IGST from this.
header.lawfulHelp: Only Admin can make a document without GST. Taxable products are refused; the bill still goes into the books and the returns.

lines.title: Items
lines.caption: Lines of this document
lines.pricesExclude: Rates exclude GST · tax is worked out by the server
lines.noSuchProduct: No active product with this code or name for this company
lines.keyboardHelp: Enter on any field of the last line adds a new line; Tab follows the paper order.

err.gstin: Choose the GSTIN this document is issued from.
err.noGstin: This company has no GSTIN yet. Add one on Branches and GSTINs.
err.lines: Add at least one line with a product and a quantity.
err.lineFormat: Check the lines: pick a product from the list; quantity up to 3 decimals, rupees up to 2.
err.against: Choose the posted invoice this credit note is against.
err.reason: Write a reason of at least 5 characters.
err.lawful: Choose the reason in law for a document without GST.

tax.title: Tax
tax.treatmentTaxable: Rate from the HSN table on the document date.
tax.treatmentWithout: Without GST, entered by Admin with a lawful reason. It still goes into the GST returns.
tax.intra: Same state, so CGST + SGST apply.
tax.posPending: Shown once a customer and a line are entered.
tax.einvoiceNote: Fetched on posting when e-invoicing applies to this GSTIN · arrives in Phase 8.

wa.title: WhatsApp
wa.notYet: A message to the customer is queued when the document is posted.
wa.senderNote: Sending starts when the owner’s WhatsApp Business account and the sender are connected; until then messages stay queued.

confirm.title: Post this {{type}}?
confirm.effect: Posts the {{type}} for {{amount}} to {{customer}}, takes the next number from the series, writes it to the books and queues the WhatsApp message. A posted document is never edited; corrections are a credit note or a reversal.
confirm.effectChallan: Posts the {{type}} for {{amount}} to {{customer}} and takes the next number from the series. A posted document is never edited.

cancelDlg.effectDraft: The draft is removed. Nothing was posted, so the books do not change.
cancelDlg.title: Cancel and reverse this document?
cancelDlg.effect: A reversal entry is posted, the document is marked Cancelled with your reason, and any queued WhatsApp message is stopped. The number stays used.

empty.noCompanyBody: Admin adds the company and its GSTIN on Companies and Branches and GSTINs first.
empty.notFoundBody: It does not exist or your sign-in does not show it.

recent.title: Recent documents
recent.emptyBody: Drafts and posted documents of this company appear here.

print.heading: Preview · {{no}}
print.irnNote: IRN and QR when e-invoicing applies · Phase 8

gst.no_rate: There is no GST rate for this HSN on the document date. Admin sets it on Product master → HSN and GST rates.
gst.without_admin_only: Only Admin can make a document without GST.
gst.reason_required: A document without GST needs a reason the law allows.
gst.taxable_without_gst: A taxable product cannot be billed without GST.

price.above_mrp: The price including tax is above the product’s MRP. Lower the rate (Legal Metrology).

posting.locked: This document is posted and can no longer change. Issue a credit note or cancel it.
posting.rule_missing: A posting rule is missing for this company, so the books cannot be written. Admin sets it on Accounts → Posting rules.
posting.no_party_group: There is no account group marked for customers or suppliers. Admin adds it on Tally books → Chart of accounts.
posting.unbalanced: The entry does not balance, so nothing was posted.
posting.already_reversed: This was already cancelled or reversed.
posting.use_document: This entry belongs to a sales document. Cancel the document instead.
posting.no_delete: Posted documents are never deleted; cancel and reverse instead.

period.no_fy: No financial year is open for this date. Admin opens it on Settings or Numbering.
period.closed: This month is closed. Ask Admin for a “Reopen a closed day or month” permission.

date.future: The date is in the future.

entries.backdate: This date is older than allowed. Ask Admin for a “Back-date entries” permission.

doc.qty: Every line needs a quantity above zero.
doc.discount: A discount cannot be more than the line value.
doc.credit_needs_invoice: A credit note must be against a posted invoice of the same customer.
doc.credit_exceeds: Credit notes cannot add up to more than the invoice.
doc.has_receipts: Receipts or credit notes are set against this document. Reverse them first.

party.missing: Choose a customer of this company.

cash.receipt_blocked: Refused: this takes the customer to the daily limit for cash received from one person (set on Settings, under the Income-tax rule on cash receipts). Take it by bank transfer, UPI or cheque.
cash.payment_over_limit: This cash payment is over the daily limit to one person. Pay by bank, or give a reason Admin will see.
cash.limits_not_set: The cash limits are not set. Admin sets them on Settings.

money.amount: The amount must be above zero.
money.account: Choose the right account: a cash account for cash, a bank account for bank, UPI, cheque or card.
money.over_allocated: An allocation is more than the bill still owes, or the allocations add up to more than the amount.
